description: 48x 10M/100M/1GBASE-T access, 4x 10/25G SFP28 and 2x 40/100G QSFP28 uplink 1RU data-centre switch running NX-OS. The port side carries all fifty-four ports and the BCN, STS and ENV lamps. The other side carries the console, an RJ-45 and an SFP management port, the USB port, three fan modules and two power supplies. Ports number 1-54 and run DOWN each column, odd on the top row. Ships port-side intake (burgundy modules) or port-side exhaust (blue).

gaps.note: The front figure draws a column of seven rings at the right end beside the QSFP28 pair and a block of nine rings under the BCN, STS and ENV lamps. Callout 1 is "LEDs" and the text names no others, and appendix C lists the BCN, STS and ENV lamps and the port lamps only. They are drawn as marks without a state.
gaps.wanted: What the sixteen rings are, and whether they are lamps.

gaps.note: The guide states no default build among its six supply and airflow combinations. The configuration `ac-350w-port-side-intake` is the base, as for the 9348GC-FX3, so that a plain chassis lists with the family's first supply; it is a choice, not a statement of the guide.
gaps.wanted: Which combination Cisco ships by default.

gaps.note: The guide says the switch "supports a mix of AC and DC power supplies in the same chassis for up to 15 minutes" (PDF p8, printed 2) and its supply list allows "a mix of AC and DC power sources" but not a mix of airflow directions. A configuration seats one supply type in both bays, so a mixed build is not written as a configuration. The bays accept every listed supply, so a user can seat the mix by hand.
gaps.wanted: Whether the 15 minute limit applies to a permanent mixed build.

gaps.note: The installation options (PDF p25, printed 19) also name the N3K-C3064-ACC-KIT, with no contents and no procedure. NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU (appendix D, PDF p69, printed 63) and NXK-ACC-KIT2-2RU (install procedure, PDF p31, printed 25) have procedures and are on main as cisco/nxk-acc-kit-1ru@1 and cisco/nxk-acc-kit2-2ru@1; the third is not modelled.
gaps.wanted: The contents or procedure of the N3K-C3064-ACC-KIT.

A drawing of the lid, the underside and the two side walls. The guide's overview shows the chassis only in the two flat views and calls out the grounding pad; no side wall is drawn and none can be measured.

A picture of the 350 W PHV and the 440 W DC supplies. The guide's figure shows AC supplies only ("AC power supplies shown"), and labels them with another product's part number. Their faces are the 350 W AC supply's with the inlet changed.
A stated size for the supplies and the fan module. The guide gives "Form factor RSP1" for the 350 W AC and PHV supplies and nothing for the fan.
A cage skin with a bail. The library's SFP cage has one skin and none shows a bail.

gaps.note: The Overview says the switch "will power down due to a fan-policy trigger if fewer than 2 fans are operational", and that with more than one rotor failed it "will issue a warning and power down in 2 minute".
gaps.wanted: Whether the first sentence counts fan modules or rotors. It is read as modules, two of three, so the group says 2+1.

attrs.redundancy-note: Installation guide, Overview: three fan modules of two rotors each. The switch "will power down due to a fan-policy trigger if fewer than 2 fans are operational". It works with one rotor failed in any one module and, with more than one rotor failed, warns and powers down in two minutes.

mgmt.mixed: the out-of-band block at the left end: an RJ-45 console port, an RJ-45 and an SFP management port and a USB port. Three media, one purpose: reaching the switch when the data plane cannot.

attrs.redundancy-note: installation guide: "Power supply modules (two-one for operations and one for redundancy [1+1])". Slot 1 is on the left and slot 2 on the right.

name: n9k-c92348gc-fx3

chassis-lamps.note: Callout 1 is "LEDs". The figure draws a boxed panel at the left end with THREE ring lamps in a column, legends BCN, STS and ENV to their left, at 10.6 mm across and 11.95, 15.95 and 19.9 mm down; there is no fourth lamp and no P (this is the non-PoE model). Under them the figure draws a block of nine small rings in three rows, some with a mark inside that the blur does not resolve, and the maker's logo mark under them; the guide does not name the rings and they are drawn as plain marks. The figure also draws a column of seven rings at the right end, beside the QSFP28 pair; they are drawn as marks and are in the gaps. No logo is drawn: the library's practice for a Cisco face is no logo artwork. The model legend under the uplinks, CISCO NEXUS N9K-C92348GC-FX3, is printed on the figure and is carried as text.

colour.note: NO SOURCE FOR THE COLOUR. The guide's figures are uncoloured line art. #d0d2cf is the value the 93180YC-EX's stencil sample gave, carried across as a family colour.

gate-1.note: The front figure's body, between its outermost end lines on the 400 dpi render of PDF p8, is 2329 px across and 232 px down: aspect 10.04 against the guide's 17.3 x 1.72 in, 10.06, so 0.2% out, and it can be measured; 5.30 px per mm both ways. A repeated feature checks the scale: the jack columns step 74.2 px, 14.0 mm, against the registry's 13.97, and the boxed groups step 477 px, 90.0 mm, so every pitch is the registry's and the figure fixes where each group starts. The rear figure is read at the same scale from its own outer end lines, 2323 px across. The figure is blurred: a reading is good to about 0.5 mm.

port-lamps.note: Appendix C, Switch Chassis LEDs (PDF p65, printed 59): "The port LEDs appear as triangles pointing up or down to the nearest port." Green is admin up, module present and link up; amber is admin down or module absent; off is up and present but no link. The figure draws the SFP28 triangles large, between the two cage rows, and the QSFP28 triangles at the ends of a band with eight small windows between them; the windows are drawn as marks and carry no state. The copper triangles are the printed arrows beside the numerals; the copper lamps are the rectangles under the jacks.

port-order.note: The figure prints a pair of numerals over each column of lamps with an up and a down triangle between them, "1 up down 2" to "47 up down 48", and "49 up down 50", "51 up down 52" and "53 up down 54" under the SFP28 and QSFP28 cages, so the odd port is the upper jack or cage. The Overview (PDF p7) gives 48 10M/100M/1G BASE-T downlink ports, 4 SFP28 uplinks and 2 QSFP28 uplinks, and the callout table (PDF p8) "10M/100M/1G RJ45 ports (48)", "SFP28 ports (4)" and "QSFP28 ports (2)". Port numbers are as printed; the NX-OS interface names are not in the guide.

power.note: Appendix B, Switch Power Input Requirements (PDF p59, printed 53, read from the page): typical 226 W and maximum 242 W "(AC or DC)", 825.738 BTU per hour. The figures are the switch's draw and not a supply rating; the guide names no configuration or ambient.

rack-ears.note: The guide's NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU procedure says the holes used depend on the rack and on the clearance needed for interface cables, 3 inches minimum, and for module handles, 1 inch minimum, and its figure shows two ways to mount the brackets. None dimensions a position and none says which the box ships with, so the two positions are written without an `at`, named for what the text says they clear, and none is the default.

rear-face.note: Art number 523973, PDF p9 (printed 3), whose text under the callout table says "The figure shows the chassis for Cisco N92348GC-FX3", so this is the model's own rear. The console jack over the RJ-45 management jack, the USB port stood on end, the SFP management port, two lamps labelled BCN and STS, a grounding symbol with two screws, three fan modules, then supply 1 and supply 2. THE OUT-OF-BAND BLOCK IS AT THE LEFT END, as on the 93180YC-EX. Every position was read off this figure and agrees with the PH guide's rear figure (a different bitmap, drawn at a different resolution) to within 0.4 mm, which is this figure's resolution, so the PH's values are used where this figure cannot say otherwise. The figure draws small airflow legends, F1 and F2 with arrows, beside the first fan and P1 and P2 beside the supplies; they are not carried. The management SFP cage is the registry's plain one. The grounding pad is drawn as the plain earth symbol; the registry's ground symbol is the circled one, so the mark is drawn.

sources.note: One guide, held as PDF and as converted text and figures; it is not committed. Cisco N92348GC-FX3 NX-OS Mode Switch Hardware Installation Guide, 70 pages, First Published 2024-10-21, Last Modified 2026-08-04 (the figures were read from the PDF pages themselves, rendered at 400 dpi, and the text from its text layer). Page numbers are PDF pages with the printed page after them. The Overview (PDF p7, printed 1) and its front and rear figures (PDF p8 and p9, printed 2 and 3; art numbers 523972 and 523973), appendix B (PDF p58, printed 52, and PDF p59, printed 53) and appendix C (PDF p65, printed 59). THE FIGURES ARE GREY BITMAPS OF 1200 PX (200 ppi JPEG, about 2.7 px per mm in the guide's own file, so they are blurred beside the PH guide's line art) and carry callouts. NO DATA SHEET, PHOTOGRAPH, 3D MODEL OR STENCIL IS HELD for this model, and the NetBox devicetype-library is held as a path listing only: no file was read, so nothing is taken from it.

stack-orientation.note: The library's convention: the upper cage upright over the lower turned 180, and the upper jack turned 180 over the lower one. The front figure draws the upper jacks with their latch notch up and the lower jacks with the notch down, which is that arrangement.

supply-label.note: THE REAR FIGURE PRINTS A LABEL ON EACH SUPPLY, above its inlet. Read at the figure's native 200 ppi it is about 6 px a glyph and reads C3KX-PWR-, then three characters the blur does not resolve (they look like 1100), then WAC: a Catalyst 3750-X supply legend, apparently left on the drawing. It is not one of the six part numbers the guide's text lists (NXA-PAC-350W-PI2 and -PE2, NXA-PHV-350W-PI and -PE, NXA-PDC-440W-PI and -PE; PDF p8, printed 2, and the weights table, PDF p58, printed 52), and the drawing says AC supplies are shown. The text is what the configurations name; the label is a drawing error, is not carried on the supplies, and adds no part.

the-width.note: The guide's Switch Dimensions table (PDF p58, printed 52): "17.3 inches (43.9 cm)" wide, "1.72 inches (4.4 cm) (1 RU)" high, and for depth "Chassis without PSUs - 18.0 in (45.72 cm)", "With NXA-PAC-350W PSUs - 19.7 in (49.9 cm)", "With NXA-PHV-350W PSUs - 19.7 in (49.9 cm)" and "With NXA-PDC-440W PSUs - 21.0 in (53.34 cm)". The guide lists no 1900 W supply. The chassis depth carried is the first, 457.2 mm: the library's depth is the chassis, and the others include the modules. 439.4 mm and 43.7 mm are carried, the inch figures converted. The weights table on the same page gives this chassis "14.5 lb (6.57 kg)"; this is the 92348GC's own row (the PH's is 14.33 lb, 6.49 kg).

the-x-axis.note: From the front figure, origin the left end line. FOUR boxed groups of six jack columns: the box lines start at 15.15, 105.1, 195.1 and 285.1 mm (a stride of 90.0), and the jacks stand 2.7 mm inside each, so the columns start at 17.5, 107.5, 197.5 and 287.5 mm. At the registry's 13.97 mm pitch the stride is a gutter of 6.2 mm. The two SFP28 columns' boxes start at 375.8 and 390.8 mm, a 15.0 mm step, and the QSFP28 pair at 409.4 mm. Read from this figure and not carried from the PH: the PH's groups start 0.05 mm away and its SFP28 step is 14.65 mm.

the-y-axis.note: From the same figure, origin the top line. The upper jack's centre is at 14.95 mm and the lower jack's at 30.55, a 15.6 mm row pitch (the PH figure reads 14.6; this figure draws its jacks about 0.5 mm lower and is blurred); with the registry's 11.0 high cell the upper jack runs 9.45 to 20.45 mm. The SFP28 boxes run 9.9 to 19.5 and 25.6 to 35.5 mm and the QSFP28 boxes the same. THE PORT LAMPS ARE SMALL RECTANGLES BELOW THE JACKS, one under each port, so common/led-rect@1 (4.6 x 2.6), two to a column, the left one for the upper port, at 38.9 mm; the numerals and a pair of arrows stand above them.
